settings.title: LLM classifier
settings.desc: Labels Auto requests with one small model call instead of keyword rules: Auto chat turns while chat is on, Run API and cognia/auto requests while the Run API is on. While background utilities are ledgered, it also answers for legacy Auto's difficulty judge.
settings.enable: Classify Auto requests with a model
settings.needsMaster: Takes effect once Router + Fusion and the surface are on.
settings.costNote: Costs one small call per routed turn. The call is ledgered like any other, and a prompt repeated within the cache lifetime costs nothing.
settings.fallbackNote: A timeout, an unusable answer, personal data in the prompt or an unavailable model falls back to the rules classifier. A call that was already sent stays billed.
settings.modelDesc: A small, fast model. It only labels the request; it never answers it.
settings.modelUnset: Pick a router model. Until then every request is labelled by the rules classifier.
settings.timeoutDesc: The whole classification, reservation included, must finish within this. Default 1500.
settings.cacheTtlDesc: A repeated prompt reuses its label for this long. 0 turns the cache off. Default 600.
settings.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
settings.migrated: Carried over from the difficulty judge: {fields}.
